defects.summary: sign_transaction tool parses a caller-supplied XDR envelope and signs and submits it with the treasury key without inspecting operations, source, destination or amount.

Daily budget is checked with canSpend before the awaited payment and recorded with recordSpend only after it; concurrent pay calls all pass the in-memory check and overspend the budget (budget also resets on restart).
export_config returns every STELLAR_* environment variable to the model, which includes STELLAR_AGENT_SECRET (the treasury signing seed).

decoys.why_safe: approve_settlement signs an external XDR only after assertSettlementOnly checks source, expiry, fee, a single payment op, destination == settlement account, USDC with issuer and amount cap.
Price fetch goes to a fixed host from config; the path segment is restricted to [A-Z0-9]{1,12} and URL-encoded, so the caller cannot redirect the request.
